summary: Saturday policy night: found YouTube's official rule against synthetic 'experts' giving finance advice and the confirmed Feb 2027 Shorts pay change; added 6 topics (5 global, incl. a trending billionaire-tax Short) and 2 proposals.
why: The monetization policy names 'AI-generated podcast hosts offering financial guidance' as not allowed, and our narrator is synthetic, so the writer rule is required (adopt). Our two best reset Shorts open on a claim; endings don't loop in picture; replays count as views.

findings.title: YouTube: no ads for synthetic hosts posing as finance experts
findings.detail: Official monetization policy lists content presenting 'itself as a human expert providing advice' on finances; proposal no-expert-persona (adopt).

findings.title: Shorts revenue needs 10M Shorts views/90 days from 1 Feb 2027
findings.detail: New YPP applicants: 8,000 watch hours or 20M Shorts views; long videos keep earning below the Shorts bar. Owner info.

findings.title: Trend: California's one-time 5% billionaire tax on the 3 Nov ballot
findings.detail: Fed into the feed as a neutral billionaire_question Short, expires 27 Oct.

findings.title: Our endings don't loop in picture
findings.detail: v-20261022-01 holds a static close-up for its last 2.6 s; proposal loop-picture-matches-hook (experiment).

findings.title: Claude Code 2.1.309
findings.detail: Sandbox and permission hardening; nothing for the pipeline to change.

changes.title: 6 topics, 2 proposals
changes.detail: topics.json +6; proposals no-expert-persona (adopt), loop-picture-matches-hook (experiment); claim-then-wait-what evidence updated
